'''David Wells''' (also published as '''Dave Wells''') posted on Decipher's [[swccg-discussion]] list in 1997.<ref name="list-7173">[http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/7173.html? swccg-discussion message #7173], [[David Wells]] (1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000229184042/http://www.egroups.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/7173.html? Internet Archive]</ref> As Dave Wells he played at [[March 2001 Flatwoods tournament]] on 10 March 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Coleman Richardson's tournament report,<ref name="tr-d1869">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-flatwoods-ky-3-10-01d1869/ flatwoods-ky-3-10-01], DeckTech (Coleman "Crashman" Richardson, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-flatwoods-ky-3-10-01d1869/ GitHub Pages].</ref> and finished 6th at the [[April 2001 Flatwoods tournament]].
